_comment: ISO/IEC 15444-4:2024 HTJ2K conformance files. Generated by regenerate.py; do not edit by hand. See ../README.md and ./COPYRIGHT.txt.

bounds.document: ITU-T T.803 (V3, 02/2024), the same text as ISO/IEC 15444-4:2024
bounds.rule: bound = Part 1 class-1 tolerance (C.6, C.7) + the additional tolerance (C.1bis, C.4bis), peak scaled by 2^(D - Dref) and rounded up, MSE by 4^(D - Dref); hifi_ht1_02 from C.8 directly
bounds.cross_check: each bound is at least the Part 1 tolerance plus the error Kakadu recorded between the transcode and its source (stats.txt), at the component's own depth, PAE and MSE each added; and where opj_decompress 2.5.0 decodes a codestream, its error is within the bound

provenance.references: the Part 1 class-1 references (../references/) for ds0 and ds1; reference_class1HF_profile1/ for hifi_ht1_02, copied verbatim; reference_jph/*.pgm for file10, written as 8-bit PGX
provenance.jph_grading: the highest-bound file of each set; file1..file9 as fileN.jp2 is graded (../jp2/manifest.json), since the codestream decodes to the same samples under OpenJPEG; file10_b12 bit-exact against reference_jph
provenance.passes: measured: opj_decompress 2.5.0 with a print of each HT block's pass count added to opj_t1_ht_decode_cblk, see HT_PASSES in regenerate.py; walked: this crate's Tier-2 walk of every packet header, see HT_WALKED
provenance.openjpeg: opj_decompress 2.5.0 on the bare codestream; sub-sampled files with -c K; for each JPH file, codestream_sha256 is the SHA-256 of each component it decodes from the bare codestream, its samples as little-endian i32
provenance.license: Conformance-only grant; see ./COPYRIGHT.txt. Excluded from the published crate via Cargo.toml `exclude`.
